title: MarkEdit Extension Registry Entry
description: One reviewed extension in the MarkEdit extension registry (extensions/<id>.json).

date.description: UTC hour when this version was checked into the registry.

url.description: HTTPS URL of the injectable .js, e.g. the built dist/<id>.js committed at a release tag.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file at url (the exact bytes the editor injects).

notes.description: Short release notes; null or a non-empty string, never blank.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

id.description: Unique identifier; kebab-case; must equal the filename.

name.description: Human-readable name; must not be blank.

description.description: One-line summary; must not be blank.

author.description: Author name or handle; must not be blank.

homepage.description: Project homepage; must be an https URL.

featured.description: Curated recommendation; featured entries are surfaced first in Discover.

versions.description: Only the newest 5 are kept, the build trims older ones. The newest is resolved as "latest".
